title: Twilio Account auth token: benign public id controls (project-policy) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 3 inputs holding public identifiers that sit next to the credential and look like it but are not secret.
rationale: Providers publish identifiers (account, key or client ids) beside their secrets. Reporting one is a false alarm, and redacting it removes information a reader legitimately needs.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T2 (tool-corroborated), but the cited sources do not include artifacts from two distinct owners, so the corroboration rule of docs/governance/evidence-classes.md is not met; the legacy expectation is recorded as project-policy pending review. Public identifier constructed to contain no credential: silence follows from construction.
